QuestInfo.name: Riding Mimiana
QuestInfo.0: How does a fully-grown #t1902005# act? I better talk to #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainer#k for the answer.
QuestInfo.1: #p1102002# told me that #t1902005# may have grown quite a bit, but it's not ready to be mounted, and told me I'll need to make it stronger by feeding #t1902005# with some of #b#p2060005#'s Supplements#k. He then instructed me to go purchase #p2060005#'s Supplements. Aren't they quite expensive?
QuestInfo.2: #p1102002# handed me a mountable #t1902005# and #t1912005#, and taught me the Monster Mount skill.

0.0: #t1902005# is all grown up right now, but you can't ride it yet. First of all, #b#t1912005##k for Mounts must have bones that are more solid than regular #t1912005#, and that takes decades for it to happen. Of course, there's also a way where you won't need to wait that long.
0.1: Do you know #b#p2060005##k of #b#m230000000##k? He has spent a long time taking care of animals and along the way, he made some unique discoveries. #bSpecial Supplements#k are one of those discoveries. All you need is #t4032117#, and #t1902005# will become healthy and sturdy enough to be Mounted on.
0.2: Go to #m230000000# and purchase Special Supplements from #p2060005#. Please remember that they won't be cheap by any means.

yes.0: In the meantime, I'll be here training #t1902005# so once it takes the supplements, it'll be ready to go.

no.0: Hmmm... You've raised #t1902005# this far, and you're giving it up now? Don't you think all that time might go to waste if you are giving up now?

1.0: So here are the supplements from #p2060005#. Let's feed this to #t1902005# right now. Ha! Oh, this is really kicking in. It may be pricey, but #p2060005#'s supplements really do the trick. Okay, your #t1902005# is now ready to be mounted. Take good care of #t1902005#, okay?

yes.0: I have also taught you the Monster Mount skill so you can actually ride #t1902005#. I have also given you a #t1912005# as a bonus, so happy Mounting!

item.0: Were you unable to obtain #b#t4032117##k? I understand... it's not cheap by any means.
